entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Advanced Class Origins
entity_raw.definition_raw:
No one is prepared for how hard you strike until they see it firsthand.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Power Attack, base attack bonus +1, sneak attack class feature.

Benefit(s): If you use Power Attack with the first melee attack you make during a surprise round, you can sneak attack even if you are not flanking your target and it’s not denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.
